name: print-social-launch-your-business-posts-purple-pink-flat-rocket-illustration
title: 'Launch Your Business' pack in purple-pink gradient with a flat rocket illustration and speech bubbles
whatItIs: Nine purple-to-pink gradient square posts with a flat illustration of a yellow-and-white rocket launching through clouds, gear icons and speech bubbles, flat-illustrated people exchanging lightbulbs and coins, and headlines ('Launch Your Business', 'Expand Your Ideas', 'We Teach You How').
whatItMeans: Optimistic and energetic; a launching rocket makes 'starting a business' feel like an exciting journey rather than a risk.
techniques: Use a rocket launch as a literal metaphor for starting a business.
Illustrate abstract exchanges (ideas, help) as literal handoffs.
Keep a consistent gradient across a full post set.

vocabulary.definition: Using a rocket or liftoff to represent starting something new.
Using the same colour fade across every asset in a set.
